logline: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 17's intimate hearthside moment; their peaceful sanctuary is shattered when arsonists trap Juliana and Alexander inside their burning home.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot on the wooden floor as bright orange flames crackle beneath the closed bedroom door, thick smoke billowing through the crevices.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Muffled crackle and roar of an encroaching blaze.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Terrified)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

segments.label: JULIANA (Muffled, Weeping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Urgency)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana! Get up!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Distressed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What happened?

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Urgent)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Fire.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Firm, Protective)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Stay close to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Panic-Stricken, Choked)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: We cannot get through!

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resolute, Calm Under Pressure)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then we go another way.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

segments.label: JULIANA (Frantic, Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The ledger!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stern, Shouting)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Leave it!

segments.label: JULIANA (Hysterical, Screaming)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No! No!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot pointing up at the ceiling beams overhead, engulfed in roaring fire and splitting down the center.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Loud, Alarmed)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring in Terror)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana!

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Weeping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It's my mother's!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Blood-Curdling)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Screaming Command)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Down!

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Panting, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I've got you.

scenes.heading: INT. COTTAGE - PARLOR / EXT. COTTAGE - CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The window!

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Determined)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Hold on to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide interior shot as the entire parlor collapses into an uncontrollable inferno of roaring flames.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Night exterior shot in the dark grass outside. Juliana sits over Alexander, brushing ashes from his face as he coughs and catches his breath.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Our home...

segments.label: JULIANA (Crying, Shattered)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Everything we had is gone.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.

segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Anguished)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Why would anyone do this?

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Someone wanted us out.

segments.label: JULIANA (Despairing, Weeping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: We have nowhere to go.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in on Alexander's face over Juliana's shoulder. His expression hardens into a mask of pure, lethal fury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's piercing eyes and combat scar bathed in the flickering orange glow of the fire.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold Fury, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana slowly pulls back slightly from his embrace, her tear-filled blue eyes looking up into his hardened features.

segments.label: JULIANA (Trembling, Apprehensive)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What are you going to do?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic hold on Alexander's grim, unyielding profile as he stares into the inferno with unshakeable resolve, the swelling score echoing a vow of vengeance into the final cut to black.
